alignment.asr: CHEAP HOSTING HAS A CATCH NEIGHBORS
alignment.caption: Cheap hosting has a catch. Neighbors.

alignment.asr: WITH SHARED HOSTING EVERY SIGHT USES THE SAME KITCHEN
alignment.caption: With shared hosting, every site uses the same kitchen.

alignment.asr: ONE NEIGHBOR GETS A RUSH OF TRAFFIC AND YOUR SIGHT MIGHT HAVE TO WAIT
alignment.caption: One neighbor gets a rush of traffic, and your site might have to wait.

alignment.asr: WITH A V P S YOU GET YOUR OWN APARTMENT
alignment.caption: With a VPS, you get your own apartment.

alignment.asr: SAME BUILDING BUT YOUR OWN OPERATING SYSTEM AND A SET SHARE OF RESOURCES
alignment.caption: Same building, but your own operating system and a set share of resources.

alignment.asr: I'D START WITH SHARED HOASTING FOR A BLOG OR A SMALL SIGHT
alignment.caption: I'd start with shared hosting for a blog or a small site.

alignment.asr: I'D PAY MORE FOR A V P S IF I NEEDED TO RUN CUSTOM'S SOFTWARE
alignment.caption: I'd pay more for a VPS if I needed to run custom software.

alignment.asr: WITH AN UNMANAGED V P S I'D HANDLE THE UPKEEP TOO
alignment.caption: With an unmanaged VPS, I'd handle the upkeep, too.

alignment.asr: WOULD YOU SHARE THE KITCHEN OR GET YOUR OWN PLACE
alignment.caption: Would you share the kitchen or get your own place?
